disconnectDescription: This will revoke access and remove stored tokens. You can reconnect later.
oauthHintBody: Integrations use OAuth2 for secure access. Configure credentials in the setup dialog or set environment variables.
setup.title: Set up {{provider}} OAuth
setup.redirectUri: Redirect URI (add this to your OAuth app)
setup.securityNote: Credentials are stored locally and never sent to third parties.

oauth2.label: OAuth2 (User Consent)
oauth2.description: Sign in with your Google account. Best for personal use — requires browser-based consent per user.

serviceAccount.label: Service Account (Domain-Wide)
serviceAccount.description: Use a GCP service account with domain-wide delegation. Best for Workspace admins — no per-user consent needed.

sa.title: Connect {{provider}} via Service Account
sa.subtitle: Paste your GCP service account JSON key and specify the Workspace user to impersonate.
sa.emailHint: The Workspace user whose data the service account will access. Domain-wide delegation must be enabled in the Google Admin console.
sa.securityNote: The private key is stored locally in your encrypted credential vault and never sent to any external service except Google's token endpoint.
sa.scopesHint: Enable these scopes for domain-wide delegation in the Google Admin console.
